about:

projects:
Computer Vision Food Recognition & Nutritional Analysis
June 2025 – October 2026
Python, PyTorch, YOLO, OpenCV, NumPy, pandas, TensorFlow
• Built a live webcam app that identifies five food categories and detects multiple items using a fine-tuned YOLO11 model.
• Averaged approximately 13.5 FPS across 300 frames. Trained on 245 hand-labelled images and reached 98% mAP50 on a held-out validation set.
• Integrated nutrition feedback and text-to-speech, including a five-month pilot with six participants.

Autonomous Robot Navigation & LiDAR Mapping — WATonomous
September 2026
C++, ROS 2, Foxglove, Docker
• Developed a four-node navigation pipeline combining LiDAR mapping, odometry-based map fusion, A* pathfinding, and 10 Hz Pure Pursuit control.
• Built 100 × 100 m occupancy grids at 0.1 m resolution, with 0.65 m obstacle inflation and eight-direction A* planning.

Autonomous Drone Behaviour Tree Telemetry
September 2026 – Present
Python, ROS 2, MAVLink, py_trees, pymavlink, Git
• Mapped observed drone behaviours to compact IDs and parent–child relationships for MAVLink STATUSTEXT.
• Built air-to-ground telemetry to reconstruct autonomy state, targeting payloads of 50 bytes or less without LTE connectivity.

Recall — AI Study Assistant Chrome Extension
October 2026 – Present
Java 21, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Vite
• Built a Manifest V3 side-panel extension that generates fill-in-the-blank quizzes from pasted or uploaded course notes.
• Added optional hints and retries for missed questions. Built a Spring Boot REST API and PostgreSQL storage for quizzes, questions, and attempts.

Autonomous Drone Software & Computer Vision Bootcamp — WARG

Python, NumPy, PyTest, Git, YAML, CI/CD
